headline: Quadrant Future Tek: SEBI Takeover Disclosure by Mohit Vohra
sum: Mohit Vohra filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, signalling a material shareholding event in Quadrant Future Tek Limited.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating that Mohit Vohra has exceeded the 5% materiality threshold in Quadrant Future Tek Limited. Regulation 31(4) requires mandatory disclosure of such acquisitions within 2 trading days. The filing triggers the obligation to make an Open Offer under Regulation 38 unless exempted. The exact quantum of shares acquired and consideration amount are not stated in the excerpt provided.
